text:
maria: Heads-up — Acme POC legal asked about our DSAR flow and deletion TTL for hosted API. Need a concise answer before Thursday's demo. cc @alex @junaid

alex: Do we have their data map? Need to confirm PII/PHI scope. If it's request/response text only, we support DPA + delete API, but retention windows differ by deployment. :thinking_face:

junaid: They already returned a SIG/CAIQ and flagged 'data_retention' + 'encryption'. My note: we support DPA and SCCs; deletion is currently soft-delete (30d) + daily purge job for hosted.

maria: They want guaranteed purge within 24h on DSAR. Can we promise that for a POC?
alex: Short answer: Hosted API standard is 30 days (DPA). For enterprise deals on Dedicated we can contract 24h purge SLA and automated purge hooks. For Hosted, we can escalate manual purge requests as a one-off during POC but shouldn't promise product-level 24h without SOW. :thumbsup:

legal-liaison: FYI our template DPA states 'data deletion within 30 days of request'; we can do an SLA addendum to shorten this. Maria — please open a redline request and tag me. DPA link: https://redwood.company/legal/dpa-v2 (internal)

maria: Will do. Also the customer asked for a sample DSAR intake + purge workflow we can share with their security team. Any sanitized runbook?
junaid: Dropping a minimal internal snippet (sanitized). Marked internal-only: 

```bash
# manual purge (internal admin API)
POST /internal/admin/purge \ 
  -d '{"customer_id":"acme-123", "request_id":"dsar-2026-03", "force":true}' 
# response: 202 Accepted -> purge kicked off, audit log entry created
```

Note: hosted purge triggers KV cache invalidation + async storage GC. For Dedicated, customer-managed retention.

alex: For presales collateral, share this high-level blurb: "We process DSARs within 30 days under our standard DPA. Enterprise contracts can include accelerated deletion SLAs (e.g., 24h) and evidence via audit logs + purge API. For POCs we can coordinate manual purges as an interim measure." Keep it simple for their security team.

maria: Perfect — I'll send that and the redline request. Looping back after their security sync. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
